_doc: GAB v1.1 configuration (see GAB.md). sets = named clip sets that earlier reports used, scored as their own rows so an old number can be reproduced on its own clips. A set matches manifest rows by suite (any suite_jobs entry '<suite>:'), optional folder prefix and optional split. coldFirst = suites whose clips were cut from inside a performance: the first Shabad/Bani is already being sung at t=0, so its find time is measured from t=0 (the app was started while it was sung), never from the truth window start. exclude = clips left out of every number, with the reason (dataset truth to fix). expectBanis = the Banis each behaviour should cover (the user's list); a Bani with no clip shows as 'no clips yet'.

sets.title: Level-2 kirtan 41 (L2 sheet, human Shabad truth)
Fremont kirtan, dev sessions (Jaspal, sevadaar screen = human line truth)
Paath 60 (recited Nitnem cuts, human Bani truth 30-60 s of each)
Aarti-50 (cold starts inside a sung Aarti, human piece truth)
Renton Oct 11 production parts (test split: reconciliation only)

coldFirst.l2: the sheet's start is a labelled pangti inside the Shabad; the 30 s before it is the same Shabad
coldFirst.paath: 70 s cuts from a continuous reading; the scored window (30-60 s) is in the middle of it
coldFirst.aarti: cuts that start at many points inside one sung Aarti
coldFirst.asa: a cut from inside a sung Asa di Vaar

exclude.pt37: the 30-60 s window is not Aarti (paath-tests not_bani); the dataset's bani:22 truth there is wrong
